subject: CareLane POC: environment selection, success metrics & owners
messages:
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@carelane.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: CareLane POC kickoff and hosting preference

Thanks for the call today — quick recap from our side. We liked the speed demo and the clarity on cost levers. Internally we need a POC that proves (1) average latency for 256-token responses under 250ms, (2) embedding accuracy on our search testset (recall@10 >= 0.65), and (3) predictable monthly spend < $2k for a 2-week pilot.

Preferred hosting: security has pushed for an isolated environment. Our default is to try a VPC deployment to keep traffic inside our cloud account; if that adds too much ramp time we can consider Redwood-hosted sandbox. We need an ops owner and a schedule for setup.

Action items on our side:
- Tom will share the PII scope doc and sample testset by tomorrow.
- Security will circulate the SOC2 questionnaire — expect questions around data retention and KV cache.

Can Redwood send a concrete checklist for each environment option (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC) and a realistic ETA for provision + test runs? Ideally we want to start the week of Oct 27.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Gomez
Head of ML Integrations, CareLane Health

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@carelane.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareLane POC kickoff and hosting preference

Great to sync — thanks for the clear success criteria. Below is a short evaluation plan + proposed environment recommendations and owners. I attached a one-page decision matrix (Redwood-Hosting-Decision-Matrix.pdf).

Evaluation plan (2-week pilot):
1) Week 0 (provisioning): choose environment, exchange minimal network creds for VPC, spin up model endpoints, deploy test harness.
2) Week 1 (functional): run embedding recall and generation latency tests against your testset (we'll provide a Jupyter notebook).
3) Week 2 (stability + cost): simulate traffic patterns, run 4-hour load windows, and capture cost and tail latency.

Success metrics (as you listed):
- Generation latency: median(256 tokens) < 250ms; p95 < 450ms
- Embedding recall @10 >= 0.65 on supplied testset
- Estimated pilot cost < $2k for a 2-week run (we'll model after environment choice)

Environment options (high level):
- Redwood Hosted (fastest): Redwood provisions and manages; fastest onramp (48–72h). Good if security can accept outbound-only traffic and limited network isolation. Pros: <3 day setup, lowest ops lift. Cons: data passes through Redwood-managed infra; limited KMS control.
- Dedicated Sandbox (reserved capacity in Redwood but isolated pool): ETA 5–7 days for provisioning; better SLA and isolation; supports customer tenancy boundary but still uses Redwood-managed KMS unless using dedicated private option. Pros: predictable throughput; cons: longer lead time.
- VPC Trial (preferred by security): we deploy in your VPC (customer-managed networking). ETA depends on networking approvals — typical window 7–14 days. Pros: strongest isolation, customer KMS and routing. Cons: requires network/infra setup, cross-account role, and a short security review.

Proposed owners and next steps:
- Redwood infra owner: Ben Carter — coordinates provisioning, quantization profile selection, and test harness deployment.
- Redwood security/ops lead: Monica Patel — to coordinate the SOC2 Q&A and network checklist.
- CareLane owner: Tom Brent — provide testsets, PII scope, and review network firewall rules.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
- Please share the PII scope doc and a service account or contact for network (Tom indicated he'll send).
- Confirm which environment you want to commit to by Oct 20 so we can hit the Oct 27 start window.

Attachments: Redwood-Hosting-Decision-Matrix.pdf (1 page decision matrix)

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Cc: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@carelane.io>
Date: 2025-10-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareLane POC kickoff and hosting preference

Kim — adding a couple of ops notes from infra perspective so we don't under-estimate lead time:
- If CareLane wants a private VPC trial, request that they open a dedicated CIDR and provide a temporary cross-account role. We'll need one-week lead time from networking to accept the role and allow inbound routes.
- For embedding accuracy runs we recommend running 3 model variants (float16, int8-Q, and a 4-bit quantized variant) to find the best cost/accuracy tradeoff; provisioning for all three in the sandbox costs ~30% more up front but lets us measure delta without reprovision.

I'll prepare a short ops checklist for Tom that lists the exact security artifacts we need (service account, firewall ranges, expected test volume). Monica — can you lead the SOC2 question responses once Alyssa's security sends them?

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
